title: Stale project sweep
description: Projects with no sessions for 7 days: summarise where they stand and recommend continue, pause or archive.

steps.name: sweep
steps.prompt: Use the control plane API at $API_URL (curl is fine; JSON responses). Useful routes: GET /projects, GET /projects/:id, GET /sessions, GET /sessions/:id/events, GET /graph/:id, GET /workflows, GET /workflows/:id, GET /brief?hours=N, GET /audit?limit=N, GET /chores, GET /ledgers?status=signed, GET /proposals, POST /workflows, POST /projects, POST /projects/:id/continue, POST /chores, POST /tasks/:id/go. GET /projects. For each project whose last session is older than 7 days (or has none): read its goal, progress and epics, inspect its workdir if present (git log, open branches, dirty files), and write STALE.md with: project, days idle, what was last done, what is blocking, and a recommendation (continue with this prompt / pause the chore / archive) with reasons.
